ads.query: Using the page, post_history, and lifetime_post_metrics_total data, can you show me all the posts with their associated page details? For each post, I want to see the page category, fan count, talking about count, were here count, along with the post's clicks and paid impressions. Please only include posts where both the page category and post clicks are available.
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    page.category,
    page.fan_count,
    page.talking_about_count,
    page.were_here_count,
    lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks,
    lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_impressions_paid
  FROM post_history
  LEFT JOIN page ON post_history.page_id = page.id
  LEFT JOIN lifetime_post_metrics_total ON post_history.id = lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_id
  WHERE page.category IS NOT NULL
    AND lifetime_post_metrics_total.post_clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM base_data

ads.query: Using campaign_history, portfolio_history, profile, ad_group_history, and ad_group_level_report, please show campaign counts and total clicks grouped by serving status and account name: get clicks from ad_group_level_report (ad_group_id, date, clicks, cost, impressions, campaign_bidding_strategy) which contains ad group-level metrics; use campaign_history (id, name, serving_status, customer_id, status, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) to get the serving status for each campaign; use profile (id, account_id, account_name, account_type, account_marketplace_string_id, country_code) to get the account name; use portfolio_history (id, budget_amount, budget_policy, budget_start_date, budget_end_date, last_updated_date) for portfolio context; and use ad_group_history (id, name, type, campaign_id, status, updated_at, modified_time) to link ad groups to campaigns. Then group by serving status and account name, and for each unique combination show the count of campaigns and the total clicks.
ads.sql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.name,
    campaign_history.serving_status,
    portfolio_history.name,
    portfolio_history.budget_amount,
    profile.account_name,
    ad_group_level_report.cost,
    ad_group_level_report.clicks
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_history ON campaign_history.id = ad_group_history.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_group_level_report ON ad_group_history.id = ad_group_level_report.ad_group_id
  WHERE campaign_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.cost IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_group_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  serving_status,
  account_name,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CAST(clicks AS INTEGER)) as total
FROM base_data
GROUP BY serving_status, account_name

ads.query: Using campaign_history, campaign_level_report, portfolio_history, and profile, please show click counts and budget amounts grouped by campaign state and portfolio name: get clicks from campaign_level_report (campaign_id, date, clicks, campaign_budget_amount, campaign_budget_currency_code, campaign_bidding_strategy, campaign_applicable_budget_rule_id) which contains campaign-level metrics; use campaign_history (id, name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) to get the campaign state for each campaign; use portfolio_history (id, name, budget_amount, budget_policy, budget_start_date, budget_end_date, last_updated_date) to get the portfolio name; and use profile (id, account_id, account_name, account_type, account_marketplace_string_id, country_code) for account context. Then group by campaign state and portfolio name, and for each unique combination show the individual click counts and budget amounts, along with how many records fall into each grouping and the total clicks for each group.
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    campaign_history.state,
    campaign_level_report.clicks,
    portfolio_history.name,
    portfolio_history.budget_amount,
    profile.daily_budget,
    COALESCE(CAST(campaign_level_report.clicks AS INTEGER), 0) as clicks_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(portfolio_history.budget_amount AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as budget_amount_clean
  FROM campaign_history
  LEFT JOIN campaign_level_report ON campaign_history.id = campaign_level_report.campaign_id
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_history ON campaign_history.portfolio_id = portfolio_history.id
  LEFT JOIN profile ON campaign_history.profile_id = profile.id
  WHERE campaign_history.state IS NOT NULL
    AND campaign_level_report.clicks IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  state,
  name,
  clicks_clean,
  budget_amount_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(clicks_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY state, name, clicks_clean, budget_amount_clean

ads.query: Using ad_hourly_report, ad_history, ad_squad_history, snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep, ad_account_history, and campaign_history, please break down spend by Ad Squad name and Account name: for each Ad Squad–Account pair, list the individual spend values, the number of records, and the total spend. Use spend from ad_hourly_report (ad_id, date, spend, impressions, swipes, conversion_purchases_value, conversion_add_billing, conversion_add_cart) which contains hourly ad-level metrics; use ad_history (id, ad_squad_id, creative_id, name, type, status, updated_at, display_url, final_urls) to connect each ad to its Ad Squad and creative; use ad_squad_history (id, campaign_id, name) as the ad squad history lookup table to get the Ad Squad name; use snapchat_ads__creative_history_prep (creative_id, ad_account_id, creative_name, url, base_url, url_host, url_path, utm_source, utm_medium, source_relation) to map each creative to the ad_account_id; use ad_account_history (id, name) as the account history lookup table to get the Account name where ad_account_id maps to ad_account_history.id; and use campaign_history (id, name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) for campaign context linked via the campaign_id in ad_squad_history, while keeping the grouping only by Ad Squad name and Account name.
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    issue_merged.merged_at,
    requested_reviewer_history.requested_id,
    requested_reviewer_history.actor_id,
    issue.state,
    issue.locked,
    pull_request_review.body,
    COALESCE(issue_merged.merged_at, '1900-01-01 00:00:00') as merged_at_clean,
    COALESCE(pull_request_review.body, '') as body_clean
  FROM pull_request
  LEFT JOIN issue_merged ON pull_request.issue_id = issue_merged.issue_id
  LEFT JOIN requested_reviewer_history ON pull_request.id = requested_reviewer_history.pull_request_id
  LEFT JOIN issue ON pull_request.issue_id = issue.id
  LEFT JOIN pull_request_review ON pull_request.id = pull_request_review.pull_request_id
  WHERE issue.state IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  state,
  locked,
  merged_at_clean,
  body_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN merged_at_clean != '1900-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY state, locked, merged_at_clean, body_clean

ads.query: Using ad_hourly_report, ad_history, ad_squad_history, ad_account_history, and campaign_history, please summarize spend and conversion purchases by ad squad: for each unique combination of ad squad name, account name, cleaned spend amount, and conversion_purchases, return the number of records and the total spend. Use ad_hourly_report as the source of spend and conversion purchases (ad_id, date, spend, conversion_purchases_value, impressions, swipes, conversion_add_billing, conversion_add_cart) which contains hourly ad-level metrics; use ad_history (id as ad_id, ad_squad_id, creative_id, name, type, status, updated_at, display_url, final_urls) to link each ad_id to an ad_squad_id; use ad_squad_history (id, campaign_id, name) as the ad squad history lookup table to get the ad squad name and its campaign_id; use ad_account_history (id, name) as the account history lookup table to get the account name where ad_account_id maps to ad_account_history.id; and use campaign_history (id, name, status, serving_status, customer_id, advertising_channel_type, start_date, end_date) for campaign context linked via ad_squad_history.campaign_id, while keeping the breakdown keyed by ad squad name and account name and including the cleaned spend amount and conversion purchases fields in the output.
ads.sql:
WITH clean_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ad_squad_history.name,
    ad_hourly_report.spend,
    ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases,
    ad_account_history.name as account_name,
    COALESCE(CAST(REPLACE(CAST(ad_hourly_report.spend AS VARCHAR), ',', '') AS DOUBLE), 0.0) as spend_clean,
    COALESCE(CAST(ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases AS INTEGER), 0) as conversion_purchases_clean
  FROM ad_squad_history
  LEFT JOIN ad_history ON ad_squad_history.id = ad_history.ad_squad_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_hourly_report ON ad_history.id = ad_hourly_report.ad_id
  LEFT JOIN campaign_history ON ad_squad_history.campaign_id = campaign_history.id
  LEFT JOIN ad_account_history ON campaign_history.ad_account_id = ad_account_history.id
  WHERE ad_squad_history.name IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_hourly_report.spend IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_hourly_report.conversion_purchases IS NOT NULL
    AND ad_account_history.name IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  name,
  account_name,
  spend_clean,
  conversion_purchases_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(spend_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY name, account_name, spend_clean, conversion_purchases_clean
